rows.note: reported as rank 3 for the Neptune Proxima showdown; unconfirmed against the current game

conditions: Only one adversary at a time: clear or convert any active Kuva Lich, Sister or Technocyte Coda first.
Ergo Glast never sells the Detron; his Corrupted Holokey shop only carries Tenet melee and the Tenet Ferrox. Every ranged Tenet weapon comes from a Sister.

groups.activity: clear the Nightmare Granum Void; inspect Candidates

rows.label: Tenet Detron Candidate
rows.note: Mercy only when the weapon preview says Detron
rows.alt: buy a converted Tenet Detron Sister (Dojo Crimson Branch)

rows.label: progenitor element
rows.note: Magnetic (Mag, Mesa, Harrow, etc.) is the popular pick, since alt-fire into a Magnetize bubble is the weapon's build; Toxin (Saryn, Nekros, Khora, etc.) is the usual alternative
rows.alt: Elemental Vice can change it later at rank 40

conditions: A Zenith Granum Crown drops from a Treasurer on any Corpus Ship mission level 31+ (Neptune, Pluto), in any Sister-controlled mission, or in Steel Path. One Treasurer spawns 2-4 minutes into a non-endless mission.
Open the Granum Void with the Zenith crown at a Golden Hand Tribute on a Corpus Ship mission level 10+, and clear at least Rank 1 of the Nightmare tier. A lower crown tier will not spawn a Candidate.
Don't open a Tribute within about 200m of extraction; it can suppress the Candidate spawn entirely.

If the preview isn't Detron, let her despawn and finish the mission. Aborting leaves that weapon in the pool; only a completed rejection removes it. With about 10 Tenet weapons in the pool, the worst case is roughly 10 Candidates.
Squad spawns mix progenitors, and only the last player to damage the Candidate can Mercy her.
You can't Mercy a Candidate while any Lich, Sister or Coda is already active.
bonuses: A 0-Forma Xoris heavy attack, or a wide-AoE frame like Uriel or Octavia, makes the Granum Void trivial; killing more Specters also gives more Void rewards. On-Call Railjack crew helps.
Waiting for the Treasurer refunds a Zenith crown each run, making the loop self-sustaining.

groups.activity: kill Hounds, reveal Requiems, test the sequence
groups.mode: long missions first, then fast ones
conditions: Requiem mods come from Requiem Eterna relics, mainly out of Kuva Siphon/Flood missions.
A wrong Parazon guess levels her up and moves her; run long missions (Survival, Defense, Excavation) for Murmurs, then short ones once you only need her to spawn.
bonuses: Stock 1-2 of each Requiem before you start, from Requiem Eterna relics out of Kuva Siphons.

disclosures.title: Oull-first Parazon
disclosures.body: Keep Oull in a slot to test placement once your first Sister has dropped one; you can often finish on the fourth attempt without knowing the third mod. Don't Parazon her with an untested guess before earning a fresh Murmur clue.

disclosures.title: surviving the fight
disclosures.body: A tanky frame (Inaros, Valkyr, Nyx, Revenant, or an Overguard frame like Rhino or Dante) solves most one-shot deaths. Cold status slows her, and a Magnetic Sister's Soul Punch clones you as a Spectralyst: usually the mystery killer people report.

rows.label: Tenet Detron
rows.note: built; Foundry delivery, her Hound fully built too

conditions: Choose Vanquish, never Convert: Convert gives an ally, not the weapon.
Bring a Railjack with decent shields and HP, or join someone else's.

rows.label: 60% bonus
rows.alt: stop at the first usable roll

conditions: Fusion takes the higher of the two bonuses, x1.1, capped at 60%.
Elemental Vice at rank 40 (5 Forma) lets you swap the element freely, so a bad progenitor roll is no longer permanent.

disclosures.title: chasing 60% is the real long tail
disclosures.body: One completionist logged 37 Sisters for the full Tenet set chasing valence. For a single usable copy, expect a handful of Hydra runs to roll the Detron plus one normal Sister hunt: a few evenings, not weeks.
